metadata.title: Groupicorn Pennsylvania IOP/PHP research directory
metadata.purpose: Internal discovery/proximity dataset for Groupicorn. Research only; not a clinical referral directory.
metadata.methodology: Physical-address-first. This Pennsylvania refresh performs a second discovery pass for every area previously below seven shortlisted provider groups, using official provider pages plus Maps/local-business, Yelp, Reddit, Psychology Today, SAMHSA/state or county directories, and major health-system searches. Shortlists use distinct provider groups, local-first ordering, and explicit neighbor labels; they are not clinical rankings.
metadata.branding_note: logo_url points to a locally stored PNG acquired from an official provider-controlled source. License clearance is not implied.
metadata.geocoding_note: Street addresses and ZIP codes are stored; coordinates are intentionally null pending an audited geocoding pass.
metadata.publication_warning: Verify current program availability, age/track eligibility, insurance, intake requirements, and accepting-patient status before public display or referral use. Telehealth offerings are not counted as physical locations.

areas.name: Philadelphia / Center City
areas.definition: Philadelphia city and central urban neighborhoods where behavioral-health programs are concentrated.
areas.scope_note: Includes Philadelphia physical locations; suburban programs remain explicitly labeled as neighbors.
areas.adjacency_basis: Direct urban and regional transit connections; not a legal service boundary or travel-time claim.

areas.name: Delaware Valley / Main Line / Chester County
areas.definition: Suburban Philadelphia catchment spanning the Main Line, western Delaware County, Chester County, and Pottstown.
areas.scope_note: Physical locations are assigned by treatment address; broader Philadelphia service claims do not move a site into the city area.
areas.adjacency_basis: Contiguous suburban corridors around Philadelphia; not a commute or eligibility claim.

areas.name: Reading / Berks County
areas.definition: Reading and the Berks County population corridor.
areas.scope_note: One verified local physical location was found in this initial pass; nearby candidates remain labeled as neighbors.

areas.name: Lehigh Valley / Allentown / Bethlehem
areas.definition: Lehigh Valley urban corridor centered on Allentown, Bethlehem, and Easton.

areas.name: Poconos / Carbon County

areas.name: Harrisburg / Lancaster / York
areas.definition: South-central Pennsylvania corridor centered on the Harrisburg, Lancaster, and York markets.
areas.scope_note: Includes one Harrisburg adult PHP and one Lancaster youth day-hospital/IOP candidate; age and program details remain distinct.
areas.adjacency_basis: Regional south-central Pennsylvania corridors; not a driving-time claim.

areas.name: Altoona / Central Pennsylvania

areas.definition: Northeastern Pennsylvania population corridor centered on Scranton and Wilkes-Barre.
